notes.title: Happy New Year! Official Soundtrack release and Winter Sale on now!
notes.notes:
Welcome to a new year of adventure! 

To start it off right, we're releasing the Original Soundtrack for Heart of the Emberstone (done by award-winning Skyrim composer Jeremy Soule) at long last to all owners as FREE DLC. Whether you own the adventure already or if you pick it up now for 50% off during the Steam Winter Sale (until January 4), just visit our store page and find the "DLC" section to download it. 

To launch the soundtrack, go the music tab in your library. If you installed the DLC and don't see the soundtrack, go to Settings > Music > Scan Now and it should appear. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/891440/Heart_of_the_Emberstone_Original_Soundtrack/

If you're new to the adventure, or are still answering the Call of the Starseed, Episode 1 is also 50% off during the sale and also includes a free OST. And of course, pick up both episodes for an additional 10% off for a grand [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/5046/The_Gallery__EP1_Call_of_the_Starseed__EP2_Heart_of_the_Emberstone/]55% discount[/url].

We've got more surprises and new reveals in store soon, so as always you can keep up with the latest releases with our swanky [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/cloudheadgames]Steam Developer Page[/url] or on social media @CloudheadGames...

notes.title: Hotfix v1.0.3 is live!
notes.notes:
Hey all, 

We're currently working toward a big update and some other surprises next month. v1.0.3 went live last night in preperation for those changes.

For all four of you that didn't see that the Steam Autumn Sale started, you can currently get Heart of the Emberstone for 20% off. You can also gift yourself or a friend Call of the Starseed for 75% off, or the price of two donuts and a double double at Tim Hortons.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/270130/The_Gallery__Episode_1_Call_of_the_Starseed/

If you've already played, spread the good word and leave us a review to let us know what you think of the adventure! Bad words are fine too but they just show up as these ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ heart emoji, so there's not much point. 
 
[h1]v1.0.3 Changelog[/h1]
---------------

-Deleting game save will now actually delete everything
-Player can no longer obtain key power early
-Fixed bug preventing key power acquisition when handedness switched
-Fixed bug causing accidental blinks after comfort turns in OVR
-Player can now comfort turn during transports
-Key object should now socket properly in the Temple
-Fix for end-game listener
-Began structual work for upcoming achievement update

notes.title: Hotfix v1.0.2 is live!
notes.notes:
In case it wasn't obvious from the title, we’ll be continuing to support Heart of the Emberstone with updates over the weeks. Bugs, performance, some content, all sorts of flavours. 

As our first step, I'd like to introduce you to v1.0.2. It's basically the Heart of the Emberstone you've come to know and love over the last 48 hours, but with some more bug fixes! Cool, right? If you've found a bug, don't forget to let us know on our handy [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/526140/discussions/3/]bug forum[/url].

But in seriousness, thank you all so much for your support since launch--it's been incredible so far. Please keep sharing your experiences in your reviews. Post your favourite moments in the forums. Let your mom know on Snapchat, or Google+, or whatever, it’s all good. Let us know what we should keep doing, and let us know what you want to see from us in the future. You know where to find us.

[h1]v1.0.2 Changelog[/h1]
---------------

-Player can no longer pull the cog lever once already in motion
-Added haptic feedback during key moment with the Gauntlet
-Disabled key Temple moment from activating early (thanks BOLL!)
-Grab highlighter added to dead crystals
-Created automated bug reporting tool ([url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/526140/discussions/3/1483233503862259084/]detailed in forums[/url])
-Added SDK/Platform versioning to output log
-Resolved spamming of some broken refs

notes.title: An Update on Heart of the Emberstone
notes.notes:
The making of Heart of the Emberstone has been an adventure on its own, and Episode 2 of The Gallery has really become its own beast. 

This is a VR adventure that hits the high notes that fans loved about EP1, but evolves the genre in some important ways. Now that the public has become more comfortable with VR, we’re taking the gloves off with lengthier gameplay, higher puzzle density and complexity, evolved VR mechanics, and a deeper dive into the narrative of The Gallery world.

We’re incredibly proud of where we’re at with the game right now; Heart of the Emberstone is really unlike anything we’ve seen before in VR. The game is effectively finished at this point, but as a small team we’ve decided to take the opportunity to put some extra love (and bug fixes) into Emberstone before launch. We’re running out of days in September, and while “Heart of the Octoberstone” doesn’t have quite as nice a ring to it, we feel it’s the right choice to make the best game for our fans.

So, here are the facts:
[list]
[*][url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/526140/The_Gallery__Episode_2_Heart_of_the_Emberstone/]The Gallery – Episode 2: Heart of the Emberstone[/url] will release on Wednesday, October 18, 2017.
[*]Emberstone runs most players between 4-6 hours, varying due to the openness of VR gameplay.
[*]We’re releasing at $29.99, and we’ll continue to offer dollar parity for our fellow Canadians.
[*]There will be a 10% bundle discount when purchasing both episodes, and a “complete the bundle” discount for existing owners of [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/270130/The_Gallery__Episode_1_Call_of_the_Starseed/]EP1 on Steam[/url].
[*]You can currently [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/526140/The_Gallery__Episode_2_Heart_of_the_Emberstone/]wishlist the game on Steam[/url] to get launch notifications and more info as it comes.
[/list]
I’ll be around for any questions that I can answer today, and some of the other devs may chime in too. You can check our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/526140/discussions/0/3223871682618312349/]FAQ over on Steam[/url] for some answers to more common questions as well.

I’m also ethically obliged to let you know that Call of the Starseed is 50% off on [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/270130/The_Gallery__Episode_1_Call_of_the_Starseed/]Steam[/url], [url=https://www.oculus.com/experiences/rift/1041269642652957/]Oculus Home[/url], and [url=https://www.viveport.com/apps/386c7d8c-1f2d-4694-996a-32ab17dec7d8]Viveport[/url] right now until October 4. (This will probably be the last sale before launch because of the way the stores work, so if you want to know what the hubbub is about before EP2 releases, don’t miss this one.)

This was a hard decision to make, but we thank you as always for your support over these last few weeks and months especially. The adventure wouldn’t be possible without you.

-Cloudhead Games

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=L4mNHJ1nDk4
